top_news.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
top_news.dek: OpenAI has expanded its GPT-6 lineup with Sol and Luna, two new models optimized for cost efficiency and faster performance.
top_news.brief: GPT-6 Sol and Luna leverage the same training methodologies as the flagship GPT-6 Astra. These models are designed to provide high-level capabilities in coding, reasoning, and computer use while reducing operational costs for professional workflows.

top_news.title: Overreliance on AI contributed to missile strike on Iran school – Pentagon
top_news.dek: A Pentagon investigation found that overreliance on AI systems contributed to a missile strike on an Iranian school.
top_news.brief: The internal probe identified a series of preventable failures in the military's 'kill chain' process. The incident, which occurred in February 2026, highlights the risks of automated decision-making in high-stakes military operations.
top_news.image_alt: Satellite imagery of the Shajarah Tayyebeh school in Minab, Iran

top_news.title: Topology-Aware Workload Scheduling with NVIDIA Topograph
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduced Topograph to optimize GPU workload scheduling by accounting for network topology.
top_news.brief: Topograph helps prevent performance bottlenecks in AI factories by ensuring GPU workloads are placed to maximize communication locality. By reducing traffic across shared links, the tool improves throughput and lowers job costs in large-scale training and inference clusters.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing GPU cluster topology and data flow

top_news.title: llm-typesafe 0.1a0
top_news.dek: The new llm-typesafe plugin for the LLM CLI tool enables structured, type-safe outputs using the Jev model.
top_news.brief: The plugin allows developers to enforce specific output formats, such as boolean or choice-based responses, directly from the command line. It integrates with TypeSafe AI's Jev model to provide reliable, schema-compliant data extraction from natural language inputs.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal window showing llm-typesafe command output

top_news.title: Microsoft disrupts AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 accounts
top_news.dek: Microsoft has dismantled EvilTokens, an AI-assisted platform used to compromise over 12,000 user accounts.
top_news.brief: EvilTokens provided an end-to-end service that automated the process of mass account compromise. The disruption marks a significant move against platforms that lower the barrier to entry for cyberattacks through AI integration.
